name: Mason Jar Black Bean "Burrito Bowl" with Corn, Bell Pepper & Rice (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from heat and spread it out on a baking sheet pan to cool, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice lime. Divide between two (quart-sized) jars.
Divide guacamole, salsa, chili powder, and salt between the jars with the lime juice.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅔ cup guacamole
⅔ cup salsa
1 tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place corn in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the jars.
Drain and rinse beans in the colander. Add to the jars.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper; medium dice. Add to the jars.
When the rice is cool, add to the jars, packing lightly if necessary.
Screw lids onto jars and store in the fridge until needed. (Best if used within 2-3 days.)
When ready to eat, empty jar into a bowl (making sure to scrape out all of the guacamole and salsa!), then stir to combine. Enjoy!
